# Repository Copilot workflow

For a SystemC-to-Spec conversion, complete and validate the candidate campaign first. The user-wide `SystemC Spec Reviewer` agent is maintained at `C:\Users\guojiamin\.copilot\agents\systemc-spec-reviewer.agent.md`; do not create repo-local or design-local copies of this agent. The Harness-generated `spec/spec.md` must visibly identify itself as a candidate pending human review; a rule marked `confirmed` means only that the bounded Evidence Gate passed, not that a human accepted the specification. If the current Harness does not mark candidate status clearly, do not present it as ready for acceptance: fix the generator for future campaigns and preserve existing immutable campaigns/releases. Before presenting a recommendation on its pending human validation, automatically invoke the `SystemC Spec Reviewer` agent with the exact final campaign path when agent delegation is available, then report its findings and ask the user for the validation decision. If the current session cannot invoke another agent, do not claim that it did; perform and disclose a read-only review in-session. Never treat an agent recommendation as the user's `accept`, and do not finalize or promote without the user's explicit authorization.
